description: Per country, whether this dataset can read the local tokenized-asset market, and why not where it cannot (e.g. a permissioned bank consortium chain in Japan, sandbox issuance in Korea, no local-currency stablecoin in India, Vietnam, Indonesia or Thailand). Covers questions such as "what is tokenized in Japan / Korea / Brazil". Without `country` it lists every market.

country.description: Country slug or name, e.g. japan, korea, brazil, india, switzerland. Omit to list all.

readable_only.description: Only markets whose instruments we can actually read (default false — the closed ones are the point)

name: get_market_coverage
title: Market coverage by country
